We also rebalanced our skill mix, including the addition of more than 18000 new employees and the ongoing retraining of the existing workforce. The increase in cos was driven by the hpes merger and was partially offset by reduction in costs associated with our labor base and real estate. Cos for fiscal 2018 included $ 192 million of pension and opeb actuarial and settlement gains associated with our defined benefit pension plans. Fiscal 2017 compared with fiscal 2016 cos as a percentage of revenues remained consistent year over year. The $ 360 million increase in cos was largely related to our acquisitions and a $ 31 million gain on the sale of certain intangible assets in our gis segment during fiscal 2016 not present in the current fiscal year.
